description: Update the workspace's AI credit alert settings. Send any of thresholds (up to 3 integers, 50 to 99, percent of plan credits used; [] turns early warnings off), notifyRoles (member and/or client, alerted besides owners and admins) and extraEmail (null clears it). Fields left out keep their values. Needs the manage workspace settings permission. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

extraEmail.description: One extra address that receives the alerts. null clears it.

notifyRoles.description: Extra roles that receive the alerts. Owners and admins always do. An empty list means owners and admins only.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

thresholds.description: Early-warning thresholds as percent of plan credits used, 50 to 99, at most 3. An empty list turns early warnings off.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_update_ai_credit_alert_settings
title: Update Ai Credit Alert Settings
